# Hooks

The checkout's behaviour with no interface attached. `useCheckout` is the whole page's state and rules; the others are the smaller pieces it and the components are built from.

## `useAnimatedHeight.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `useAnimatedHeight` | Animates an element's height whenever `dependency` changes, from the height it had before the change to the height its new content needs. Returns the ref to attach. |

## `useCheckout.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `useCheckout` | The checkout's state and rules with no interface attached: what was typed, which errors show, shipping rates, discount, totals, validation and placing the order. `Checkout` is built on it, and a custom layout can be too. |

## `useReducedMotion.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `useReducedMotion` | True when the visitor asked the system for reduced motion. Updates if the setting changes. |

## `useShippingRates.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `RatesStatus` | empty: no complete address yet. loading: asking. none: the address cannot be shipped to. ready: rates to choose from. |
| `useShippingRates` | Shipping rates that follow an address. They load once the address is complete and again whenever it changes, after a short typing pause. A slow answer for an old address is ignored. |

## `useSuggestions.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `useSuggestions` | Suggestion-list state with the race handled: when lookups overlap, only the latest one's results are shown, and closing the list discards a lookup still in flight. |
